import os, subprocess, sys, time; sys.path.insert(0,'tests/integration'); from headless_audio_lab.process_supervisor import ProcessSupervisor; f=None
try:
    with ProcessSupervisor() as sup:
        i=sup.start_process('probe',['/bin/sleep','2'],{},'.','/dev/null','/dev/null')
        assert i.pid>0 and i.pid in sup.get_owned_pids(), 'owned not registered'
        try:
            sup.start_process('bad',['/nonexistent/binary-xyz'],{},'.','/dev/null','/dev/null')
            raise SystemExit('bad command did not propagate')
        except Exception:
            pass
        f=subprocess.Popen(['/bin/sleep','3'],start_new_session=True,
                           stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        assert f.pid not in sup.get_owned_pids(), 'foreign registered'
        sup.cleanup(timeout=5.0)
        assert not os.path.exists('/proc/%d'%i.pid), 'owned survived cleanup'
        assert sup.verify_cleanup()==[], 'verify_cleanup not empty'
        assert os.path.exists('/proc/%d'%f.pid), 'foreign killed by supervisor'
finally:
    if f is not None and f.poll() is None:
        f.terminate()
        try:
            f.wait(timeout=5.0)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            f.kill(); f.wait(timeout=5.0)
print('ft-a4 owned/foreign/cleanup ok')
